name: 蜂群
description: A coordinator, workers and a verifier work in parallel on one goal, coordinated on a durable shared board: one plan approval, enforced ownership of paths and commands, members that sleep until mentioned, a monitor without a model, and a Swarm pane with board, members and a replayable mention graph.

features.name: 一次批准整个蜂群计划（成员、可写路径、可运行命令）
features.nameEn: One approval of the whole swarm plan (members, owned paths, allowed commands)

features.name: 成员只能写自己的路径、只能运行列出的命令（完全访问模式下也一样）
features.nameEn: Members write only their own paths and run only listed commands (also under full access)

features.name: 持久共享看板：@成员、@分组、@all，发送者由宿主标注
features.nameEn: Durable shared board: @member, @group, @all, sender set by the host

features.name: 频道、分片前缀、行内 @ 提及与 #seq 引用
features.nameEn: Channels, shard prefixes, inline @mentions, and #seq citations

features.name: 成员空闲时不消耗模型，被提及才唤醒
features.nameEn: Idle members cost nothing and wake when mentioned

features.name: 无模型监视：全员停滞时提醒协调者，超限标记停滞
features.nameEn: Model-free monitor: nudges the coordinator when all go quiet, marks stalls

features.name: 限流/失败分级、不失上下文热切模型与任务安全接管
features.nameEn: Quota/error classification, session-preserving model switching, and scoped task reassignment

features.name: 验证者检查改动并给出结论，可用不同模型
features.nameEn: Verifier checks changes and reports a verdict, on any model

features.name: 每个蜂群可选工具调用判定模型
运行中动态增员、分片扩容、助手归属与温上下文分叉
features.nameEn: Mid-flight worker/shard addition, worker-owned helpers, and warm context forking
